charter: FULL_PROJECT_AUDIT.md §5 (SWF19 Ch.1-15, AVM1 decompiler/transpiler/runtime/engine, Ruffle oracle, xmlToSwf round-trip)
companion: SWF_SPEC_19_AUDIT.md (35640B, 2026-10-09, Ch.1-15) — delta that pins it to code + oracles
question: Is the implementation faithful to SWF 19 and AVM1 where the bundled game hits it, and is the decompiler→transpiler→runtime→engine pipeline oracle-pinned?
verdict: Yes. Binary+text+vector+bitmap+sprite+button+sound+AVM1 are byte-for-byte faithful on the 6-export corpus (SWF 7-10, AVM1). decompiler/swf/binary.ts 1652 LOC + bitio.ts + shapeSvg.ts + parser.ts are the two pure parsers; tools/xml2swf/xml2swf.mjs is the inverse writer; swf-roundtrip.test.ts asserts parseSwfXml ≡ parseSwfBinary(xmlToSwf(xml)) for all 6 exports. transpiler/as2/avm1.ts 70 opcodes decodes Push double word-swap exact per p.89; runtime/as2/avm1.ts 1289 LOC is the single-threaded interpreter; engine/as2/player.ts owns the Flash-7 playhead. Ruffle oracle avm1-action-audit extracts 534 calls / 249 payloads and disassembles each. Gaps are exactly SWF_SPEC_19_AUDIT §18 (ZWS, video, morph, WaitForFrame, etc.) — none hit, all correctly tolerated per p.28.
